rows.new_card_markdown:
[How do AI search crawlers differ from AI training crawlers?](how-do-ai-search-crawlers-differ-from-ai-training-crawlers.md)

Search crawlers such as OAI-SearchBot fetch pages for answers; training crawlers such as GPTBot collect data for model training. Each has its own robots.txt token, so you can allow one and block the other.
